name: Non-disclosure agreement (NDA)
definition: Protects confidential information disclosed for a defined purpose and may be mutual or unilateral.

name: Master services agreement
definition: Sets reusable legal and commercial terms for services ordered through statements of work.

name: Statement of work
definition: Defines project-specific scope, deliverables, schedule, responsibilities, and fees under a broader agreement.

name: Software-as-a-service agreement
definition: Governs hosted software access, service levels, data, security, support, and subscription payment.

name: Supply agreement
definition: Governs repeated supply of goods, forecasts, ordering, delivery, quality, and payment.

name: Distribution agreement
definition: Authorizes distribution or resale within defined products, channels, territory, and restrictions.

name: Stock purchase agreement
definition: Transfers shares or other equity interests from sellers to buyers.

name: Asset purchase agreement
definition: Transfers specified assets and assumed liabilities of a business.

name: Merger agreement
definition: Sets terms and conditions for combining entities through a statutory merger or similar transaction.

name: Shareholders agreement
definition: Governs ownership, voting, transfer restrictions, governance, and exit rights among shareholders.

name: Joint venture agreement
definition: Creates and governs a shared venture, including contributions, control, economics, and exit.

name: Securities subscription agreement
definition: Documents an investor's agreement to purchase securities subject to stated terms and representations.

name: Employment agreement
definition: Defines an employee's position, compensation, duties, benefits, restrictions, and termination terms.

name: Offer letter
definition: Summarizes proposed employment terms and conditions before or at hire.

name: Independent contractor agreement
definition: Governs services by a non-employee contractor and allocates status, payment, IP, confidentiality, and risk.

name: Employment separation agreement
definition: Documents employment separation, payments, releases, return of property, and continuing obligations.

name: Restrictive covenant agreement
definition: Contains non-competition, non-solicitation, confidentiality, or related post-relationship restrictions.

name: Collective bargaining agreement
definition: Sets collectively negotiated wages, hours, benefits, procedures, and other working conditions.

name: Premarital agreement
definition: Addresses property, debt, support, and related rights before marriage, subject to applicable law.

name: Postmarital agreement
definition: Addresses spouses' financial and property arrangements after marriage, subject to applicable law.

name: Marital settlement agreement
definition: Resolves property, debt, support, and related issues in connection with separation or dissolution.

name: Family separation agreement
definition: Sets agreed financial and personal arrangements while family-law parties live separately.

name: Parenting plan
definition: Documents custody, decision-making, parenting time, communication, and related child-focused arrangements.

name: Commercial lease
definition: Governs possession and use of commercial premises, rent, maintenance, risk, default, and remedies.

name: Residential lease
definition: Governs possession and use of residential premises subject to mandatory local law.

name: Real estate purchase agreement
definition: Sets terms for purchase and sale of real property.

name: Construction agreement
definition: Governs project scope, price, schedule, changes, payment, insurance, and completion.

name: Easement agreement
definition: Creates or documents rights to use another person's real property for a defined purpose.

name: Loan agreement
definition: Documents a lender's extension of credit and the borrower's repayment and covenant obligations.

name: Credit agreement
definition: Creates revolving, term, or other credit facilities with borrowing conditions and lender protections.

name: Promissory note
definition: Contains a written promise to pay a stated debt according to specified terms.

name: Security agreement
definition: Grants a security interest in collateral to secure an obligation.

name: Guaranty
definition: Creates a guarantor's obligation concerning another person's debt or performance.

name: Software license agreement
definition: Grants rights to use software subject to scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability terms.

name: Patent license
definition: Grants defined rights under specified patents subject to field, territory, royalties, and other conditions.

name: Trademark license
definition: Permits use of specified marks subject to quality control, form, territory, and brand requirements.

name: Data processing addendum
definition: Defines privacy and security duties for processing personal information on another party's behalf.

name: Terms of service
definition: Sets rules for access to and use of a product, website, platform, or service.

name: Consumer subscription agreement
definition: Governs recurring consumer access, charges, renewal, cancellation, and service terms.

name: Consumer warranty
definition: States repair, replacement, refund, exclusions, duration, and claim procedures for a product or service.

name: Government procurement contract
definition: Governs acquisition of goods or services by a public entity under applicable procurement rules.

name: Grant agreement
definition: Provides funding for an approved public or charitable purpose subject to conditions, reporting, and oversight.

name: Government subcontract
definition: Passes defined performance and regulatory duties from a prime contract to a subcontractor.

name: Business associate agreement
definition: Allocates privacy and security duties involving protected health information between covered and service entities.

name: Healthcare provider agreement
definition: Governs participation, payment, service, records, compliance, and quality duties of a healthcare provider.

name: Clinical trial agreement
definition: Governs research conduct, funding, data, publication, safety, IP, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance.

name: Data use agreement
definition: Sets permitted uses, safeguards, disclosures, retention, and disposition for shared data.
